limitations: Heisenberg Lie bracket in dimension three; nonzero associative square contained in the one-dimensional bracket-derived ideal. Not a classification of all three-dimensional Poisson algebras. Primary arXiv:2609.13784v1 full text was inaccessible in this review; historical overlap risk remains.
scientific_integrity: The non-Dedekind sector and the characteristic-two derivation jump constitute the targeted new contribution. The previously published anisotropic odd-field subfamily is credited. Proof is mathematical; finite-field checks are corroboration only.
title: Finite-field symmetry strata of three-dimensional Heisenberg Poisson algebras
